start.content: They speak of him in the palaces as if he were a tactical problem to be mapped out and solved. They did not see the graves open. They do not know what it feels like to have seven demons wrenched out of your mind by a single word. My memory is the only anchor I have left, and I will not look away from it.

choices.text: Are you not afraid of the high priest's guards?
What does he mean when he speaks of his upcoming departure?

fear.content: Fear is a clothing I took off a long time ago. Let them watch the house. The stone has already been rolled away from my past; they cannot lock me back inside it.

departure.content: He speaks in shadows, but his eyes look straight through the horizon. He is preparing us for a night where there will be no lanterns to follow.

closing.content: The conversation is over. Go in peace.
